definitions.gloss: insect bite; insect sting; bug bite
definitions.explanation: A bite or sting from an insect such as a mosquito, flea, or bee, or the resulting skin irritation.

examples.japanese: {虫刺|むしさ}されに{薬|くすり}を{塗|ぬ}った。
examples.english: I applied medicine to the insect bite.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}はキャンプに{行|い}くと{虫刺|むしさ}されがひどくなるので、{虫除|むしよ}けスプレーが{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: In summer, insect bites get bad when camping, so bug repellent spray is essential.

notes:
Derived from {虫|むし} (insect) and {刺|さ}される (to be stung/bitten), forming a compound noun. Refers to any kind of insect bite or sting, most commonly mosquito bites in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虫刺|むしさ}されの{薬|くすり}: insect bite medication
- {虫刺|むしさ}されの{跡|あと}: insect bite mark
- {虫刺|むしさ}されを{掻|か}く: to scratch an insect bite
- {虫刺|むしさ}されが{腫|は}れる: an insect bite swells up

RELATED WORDS:
- {虫除|むしよ}け: insect repellent
- {蚊|か}に{刺|さ}される: to be bitten by a mosquito
- かゆみ{止|ど}め: anti-itch medication
- {蜂|はち}に{刺|さ}される: to be stung by a bee
